en: Only accessories have affinity effects.{SAUT}They increase evasion to affinity attacks.
Weapons with a status ailment bonus{SAUT}will add that to your attack, so that foes{SAUT}might get afflicted with the ailment.
If armor has a status ailment bonus, it{SAUT}increases your resistance to that ailment.
Status-increasing effects raise your stats,{SAUT}whether they be from weapons or armor.
Weapons with piercing or splash effects {SAUT}can hit multiple targets.
There are other effects that do not work{SAUT}during battles.{PAGE}These effects grant bonuses to{SAUT}post-battle results.
